pages.text: Drag the point, or tap a crossing. Its label gives its [[coordinates]]. Moving it along changes the first, and moving it up the second.

pages.name: Plot a point
pages.task: Plot (4, 1). Drag the point there, or tap the spot.
pages.why: Start at the origin, go 4 along the x-axis, then 1 up. The first number is how far along, so (4, 1) sits low and to the right.

pages.why: Time runs along the bottom, so go 3 along, then 4 up for the level. The reading is the point (3, 4).
